sentences.text:
Author: M.Laxman
Bench: M.Laxman
 The Honourable Sri Justice M.Laxman
 Criminal Petition No.5139 Of 2023
Order:
1.
This petition is filed seeking anticipatory bail under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 (Cr.P.C).

The petitioner herein is accused No.2 in Crime No.248 of 2023 of Station House Officer,
Malkajgiri Police Station, Rachakonda.
The offences alleged against the petitioner/ accused No.1 are under Sections 376 (2)(n), 420, 342, 354 and 354-C of Indian Penal Code.
2. The sum and substance of case of the prosecution is that Accused No.1 allegedly lured the victim to come to his home on the pretext of his mother was ailing and to attend her mother.
At the request of the petitioner/accused No.1, she went to his house.
When the victim visited his house, the petitioner/accused No.1 sexually abused and such activities continues for three or four times by threatening her by taking nude photographs.
There is allegation that other accused also similarly indulged with the victim on different occasions in different incidents.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner/accused No.1 contended that the other accused were enlarged on bail.
The petitioner/accused No.1 requested for grant of bail was rejected on the ground that investigation is pending.
It is further contended that charge sheet is filed, whereas, while granting bail to other accused it was noted that investigation is completed.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail by contending that the petitioner is a rowdy sheeter and there are multiple criminal cases against him.
There is serious allegation of commission of offence of confining the victim and threatening her.
5. A close scrutiny of the remand report of petitioner/ accused shows that the petitioner has previously involved in 50 criminal cases including dacoit, attempt to murder, theft and other offences.
When there are serious allegations of wrongful confinement on multiple occasions.
Considering the past history of the petitioner/ accused No.1, it is not a fit case to grant bail to the petitioner/accused No.1 at this stage.
8. Accordingly, the Criminal petition is dismissed.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
